messages:
clara: quick report - found a reproducible parity bug in the Go embedding helper when auth refresh + retry happens mid-batch. padding gets lost and one returned vector is 1535 vs expected 1536.

clara: repro steps: use devex batcher (go helper v0.2.4), send 3 docs padded to 4, force token expiry between enqueue and send.

ryan: can you paste the truncated response?

clara: snippet:
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[...1536 floats...]},{"embedding":[...1536...]},{"embedding":[...1536...]},{"embedding":[...1535 floats...]}]}
```

aziz: sounds like mutable pad metadata got mutated before retry. we snapshot metadata for retry in node, but go helper mutates in place.

clara: logs show: 
```
[batcher] enqueue batch id=42 pad_index=3
[auth] 401 -> refresh -> retry
[batcher] replaying batch id=42
```
then response assembled without checking lengths.

ryan: immediate mitigation: SDK should validate each embedding length against model profile and return an error if mismatch. we'll add an EmbeddingShapeError. also patch go helper to clone pad flags at enqueue time.

aziz: filed DE-4902: "go batcher: pad snapshot lost during auth-retry -> short embedding" with logs + repro. devex-bot attached.

devex-bot: created issue DE-4902 and linked PR template.

clara: thanks. I'll add a small integration test that expires token mid-batch and asserts no short vectors.

ryan: server ask: can runtime include "embedding_dim" in response metadata? that'll make fast validation cross-language trivial. cc @eng-runtime.

clara: yep please. shipping SDK checks first, then ask runtime to add embedding_dim in /v1/embeddings response body.

aziz: patch ready, unit tests added, will post canary link.

clara: great, will validate sample-app once canary available.
